claims.text: For a monthly tenancy in Kwara, your landlord must give you one month's notice.
For a yearly tenancy in Kwara, it's half a year's notice.
If you are a tenant at will, you may not be entitled to any notice at all in Kwara, under Chapter L4 of the Landlord and Tenant Law.
The nature of your tenancy is determined by when rent is paid or demanded.
